In detail

Aventino is one of Rome's quietest and most upscale central neighborhoods, a hill of villas, convents, parks (including the Giardino degli Aranci with its famous keyhole view) and low-density residential streets. It is consistently described in local guides as among the calmest parts of the city center. No documented incidents of crime, disorder or degrado specific to Aventino were found in current Italian press. No specific safety concerns documented in recent local press for this area.

Frequently asked questions

Is Aventino safe?

Wandroz rates Aventino in Rome as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Rome. That rating rests on an area-level review that reached no traveller-relevant reporting specific to Aventino — no incidents, no recurring problems, nothing documented either way — read together with the character of the area. It is not a positive finding of safety: an absence of reporting is weaker evidence than the sourced ratings elsewhere on this map, and it is marked as such wherever it appears.

What was checked for Aventino?

The same area-level review every other neighbourhood on the Rome map gets: local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist, searched for this specific area. Aventino returned nothing traveller-relevant, which is common for smaller administrative areas without a press profile of their own. Where a review does return something, the sources are named on the area's page.

Is Aventino a good area to stay in as a tourist?
